about: Rough planning estimates for the budget finder. Not live prices. Flights come from a distance-based fare curve calibrated to typical round-trip economy fares; hotels are typical nightly prices for a double room; daily spending reuses each city's dailyBudget.

ubud.via: Fly into Bali (Denpasar), then about an hour by road

venice.note: Day-tripper access fee and gondolas are extra.

santorini.via: Usually via Athens, or by ferry
santorini.note: Summer prices run well above these, especially for caldera views.

fez.via: Often via Casablanca or a European hub

arusha.via: Kilimanjaro airport, usually via Nairobi, Addis Ababa or Doha
arusha.note: Safari packages are extra and usually USD 250–500 a person a day.

cusco.note: Machu Picchu train and entry are extra, roughly USD 150–300 a person.

springdale.via: Fly into Las Vegas, then drive
springdale.note: Park entry is extra; non-U.S. residents pay a USD 100 supplement at some parks.

flagstaff.note: Grand Canyon entry is extra; non-U.S. residents pay a USD 100 supplement.

moab.via: Fly into Salt Lake City, then drive
moab.note: Park entry is extra; non-U.S. residents pay a USD 100 supplement at some parks.

jackson.via: Small mountain airport with higher fares
jackson.note: Park entry is extra; non-U.S. residents pay a USD 100 supplement at some parks.

mariposa.via: Fly into San Francisco or Fresno, then drive
mariposa.note: Park entry is extra; non-U.S. residents pay a USD 100 supplement at some parks.

nara.via: Reach it by train from Osaka or Kyoto

zanzibar.via: Usually via Nairobi, Dar es Salaam or the Gulf
zanzibar.note: Diving and boat trips are extra.

dubrovnik.via: Often via Zagreb or a European hub outside summer

reykjavik.note: Day tours and car hire are the largest cost and are not included.

amalfi.via: Fly into Naples, then about 90 minutes by road or ferry

fukuoka.via: Direct flights from much of Asia, otherwise via Tokyo or Osaka

hoi-an.via: Fly into Da Nang, then about 45 minutes by road

agra.via: Usually by train or road from Delhi

petra.via: Fly into Amman or Aqaba, then 2 to 3 hours by road
petra.note: Petra entry is 50 to 60 JOD for one to three days unless covered by a Jordan Pass.

luang-prabang.via: Usually via Bangkok, Hanoi or Vientiane

queenstown.note: Activities such as bungy, jet boats and Milford flights are the main cost and are not included.

banff.via: Fly into Calgary, then about 90 minutes by road
banff.note: Park pass, shuttles and gondolas are extra.

victoria-falls.via: Usually via Johannesburg, Addis Ababa or Nairobi
victoria-falls.note: Park entry is about USD 50 and activities are priced in US dollars.

galapagos.note: National park entry (USD 200 for most foreign adults) and day boats (USD 150 to 300 each) are extra.

koh-samui.via: Via Bangkok, or Surat Thani plus ferry

ayutthaya.via: Via Bangkok, about 80 km by train or road

antalya.via: Direct from many European cities; otherwise via Istanbul

bodrum.via: Direct from Europe in summer; otherwise via Istanbul

koh-phangan.via: Via Bangkok to Koh Samui or Surat Thani

koh-tao.via: Via Bangkok to Chumphon or Koh Samui

fethiye.via: Direct from Europe to Dalaman in summer; otherwise via Istanbul

kas.via: Via Istanbul to Dalaman or Antalya, then by road

izmir.via: Direct from some European cities; otherwise via Istanbul

sources.name: Google Flights price insights (typical price ranges)
Numbeo cost of living and hotel indexes
European Central Bank reference exchange rates
Kayak: best time to travel (monthly price lows and highs)
Google Flights: cheapest times to book and fly

seasonAbout: Each city's months are rated L (low), S (shoulder), H (high) or P (peak) for hotel demand, from tourism-board calendars, school holidays, festivals and typical hotel price swings. A city's hotel numbers are its year-round average; the month factors are rescaled so they average 1 across the year.
